monthly_return_definition: Compounded monthly simple returns for complete common XNYS trading months.
estimation_method: Demeaned exponentially weighted sample covariance using the same ewma_sample_covariance implementation as covariance_diagnostics.py.
walk_forward_rule: At each monthly rebalance, use only the trailing 60 complete monthly return vectors strictly before the rebalance month.
month_ahead_convention: month_ahead=1 is the rebalance month; 2 and 3 are the next two calendar months.
horizon_covariance_assumption: A static EWMA estimate does not model future changes in volatility or correlation. The origin covariance matrix is therefore carried forward unchanged for horizons 1-3.
not_cumulative_covariance: Each matrix is the covariance of an individual forecast month's return vector. It is not the covariance of cumulative returns over 2 or 3 months.

training_lambda_selection.selection_criterion: Lowest mean multivariate Gaussian NLL on common training-only rolling-origin forecasts.

latest_available_origin.horizon_covariance_assumption: Same origin covariance carried forward for horizons 1-3.
